policy: Kids mode lists only games that pass all four bars: no open chat with strangers, no unmoderated multiplayer chat or user-generated content, no gambling mechanics, no graphic or horror content. Assessments are honest snapshots — not guarantees. When an assessment could not be fully verified the entry is flagged verify_live ('play the first 10 minutes together'). When in doubt, the game was excluded, never softened.

age_bands.5-7: Young kids — one-button toys and sandboxes.
age_bands.8-10: Older kids — puzzles and gentle games with reading.
age_bands.11-12: Pre-teens — harder puzzles and slower strategy.
